description: Returns what the OOO Works AI-ready badge says for a site (can read, partly, blocked, can't test, or not checked), when it was checked, and the HTML to show the badge. Read-only: it never starts a check. The badge reflects OOO Works' check of robots.txt and the server's answers to each AI crawler's name at that time; it isn't a certification. For a fresh result, run check_ai_crawler_access on the site's homepage.

host.description: the website's host name, e.g. example.com

name: get_ai_ready_badge
title: What does this site's AI-ready badge say?
